summary: Moderate: go-toolset:rhel8 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
Go Toolset provides the Go programming language tools and libraries. Go is alternatively known as golang.   

Security Fix(es):  

  * cmd/go: golang: cmd/go: arbitrary command execution via untrusted GCC spec files (CVE-2026-97034)
  * cmd/go: cmd/compile: golang: golang: arbitrary code execution via crafted cgo compiler directives (CVE-2026-97043)
  * cmd/go: golang: cmd/go: arbitrary code execution via crafted cgo directives (CVE-2026-97035)
  * net/[http](http): golang: net/[http](http): Denial of Service via race condition when handling oversized HTTP/1 requests (CVE-2026-97054)
  * cmd/go: golang: cmd/go: Arbitrary code execution via unsafe cgo compiler and linker flags (CVE-2026-97033)
  * cmd/compile: cmd/link: golang: golang: Arbitrary code execution via external linker flag injection (CVE-2026-97041)
  * cmd/go: cmd/link: golang: golang: Arbitrary code execution via crafted .syso files (CVE-2026-97040)
  * cmd/go: golang: cmd/go: arbitrary code execution via malicious cgo linker flags (CVE-2026-97037)
  * cmd/go: golang: cmd/go: arbitrary code execution via crafted cgo linker flags (CVE-2026-97036)
  * cmd/go: golang: cmd/go: Arbitrary code execution via crafted linker inputs (CVE-2026-97038)
  * cmd/go: golang: cmd/go: arbitrary code execution via crafted pkg-config directives (CVE-2026-97039)
  * cmd/cgo: cmd/compile: cmd/link: golang: Go: Arbitrary code execution via unsafe linker arguments on Windows (CVE-2026-97042)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * Update Go to version 1.26.11+1 [rhel-8.10.z] (JIRA:RHEL-311806)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
